_about: How Othos should SAY words the Rime voice gets wrong. Left: the word as written (not case-sensitive). Right: a spelling that sounds right. Only the voice changes; the on-screen transcript keeps the real spelling. Edit in Notepad++, then close and reopen Othos. (Place names go in personal.json's "pronunciations". GPU model numbers like 4060 -> 'forty sixty' are handled in agent.py.)
